quarterly_data.quarter: Eoptolink investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: its 1.6T optical modules have entered a sustained volume ramp with shipments expected to keep accelerating; the whole supply chain remains relatively tight, and the company has stocked materials in advance through lock-in agreements and prepayments to secure supply.

quarterly_data.quarter: Eoptolink investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: it has a full layout across pluggable, NPO and CPO; the routes do not replace one another and customers choose by their own needs; it sees customers' large-scale demand for pluggable optical modules as certain and sustained, and is confident of winning a place in CPO products once a CPO ecosystem forms.
